findings.address_as_written: Remodeling of Tea Booth; Landscaping portion of G.G.Park Tea Garden
findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners approved a plan for a remodelled tea booth in the Japanese Tea Garden and set aside $3,000 to landscape the part of the garden where buildings had lately been demolished.

citation.label: Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners, January 14, 1943, Resolution No. 717
